newsitem.title: USA: Health & Retirement buys $171 mln properties.
newsitem.headline: Health & Retirement buys $171 mln properties.

text.p: Health and Retirement Properties Trust said on Thursday that it has acquired one retirement community, 20 medical clinics and two medical office buildings with attached garages for a total of $171 million.
The acquisition of the retirement community occurred on May 7, 1997 and the other properties were acquired May 15, the company said.
In a separate development, Health and Retirement also said it has purchased a property in Phoenix which is leased to the General Services Administration as a field office for the FBI.
Health and Retirement said it used cash on hand and borrowings under its bank revolving line of credit to fund the acquisitions, the company said.
Cash flow from these properties is expected to exceed a 10 percent a year initial return on invested capital, the company said.
Health and Retirement declined to provide a breakdown of its purchase prices or expected returns on a per building basis.
